subject: Commercial remedy request — model catalog timing impact
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@openform.example.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Need commercial remedy for model-catalog delay

Hi Priya,

Quick note from our CTO: the model catalog feature (multi-model rollout that lets us pin model families per route) was a gating dependency for our Q2 launch. Your product team communicated an "early Q2" target in January; we just learned the engineering date slipped into late Q3. This gap materially changes our go-live plan and revenue recognition on our side.

We value Redwood and want to stay on track, but we need a commercial mitigation for the schedule delta — ideally a one-time credit or a short-term rate reduction while we work through the delay. Can you advise next steps and whether Redwood would consider something like a 20% credit for three months or a one-off credit capped at $25k?

I've attached our purchase order excerpt and the SOW callout for the feature.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Engineering, OpenForm Inc

Attachments: purchase_order_of_2028.pdf (stub), sow_model_catalog_clause.pdf (stub)

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Need commercial remedy for model-catalog delay

Folks — forwarding OpenForm's ask. Short version: their Q2 launch depends on the model-catalog enhancement (route pinning/multi-model catalog) and they saw our target slide. They want a commercial remedy (credit or temporary rate) to bridge to our delivery.

What I need: 1) Product confirmation of schedule & whether there's a mitigant we can offer (partial rollout, feature flag, documented workaround). 2) Commercial proposal from Ben — what bounds do we have for a one-off credit vs. conditional credit tied to milestones? 3) If we can do anything, can we get a quick exec ok from Lauren so we can respond today? OpenForm is pushing procurement timeline.

I've attached the contract excerpt they sent.

Priya
Account Executive — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: contract_excerpt_v2.pdf (stub)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Need commercial remedy for model-catalog delay

Priya, Ben —

Product update (short): the multi-model catalog work was reprioritized to address a higher-severity routing regression (PL-1398). Current engineering forecast puts a beta rollout to Dedicated customers in the 2028-08 sprint with GA in late Q3 (targeting 2028-09-20). We can accelerate one part of the work (route-level pinning) to an earlier internal patch, but that will be limited: the simplified routing flag would allow OpenForm to pin one model per route and achieve most of their go-live needs, but it won't include the console-level model family management or automated migration tooling.

Mitigant we can offer:
- Early-release route pinning flag for their Dedicated environment (requires a config change and a scoped QA run) — ETA 2028-05-15 for a gated release if we prioritize now.
- Temporary concierge support during cutover week (no extra charge) to reduce integration risk.

Trade-offs: the early flag is not fully QA'ed across all sequences; there's a small risk on KV-cache interactions at long context lengths. I'm happy to sign off if we pair an SRE on verification and include a burn-in window.

If Commercial wants to couple a credit to milestone dates (e.g., credit if GA not met by 2028-09-30), Product is fine with this conditional approach. We just need clear accept/decline cutoffs and to avoid open-ended commitments.

— Marissa
Director, Product — Serving & Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Need commercial remedy for model-catalog delay

Thanks for the context. Commercial proposal below — keeping it conservative but customer-friendly so we protect revenue and set clear guardrails.

Proposal options (pick one):
A) Milestone-tied conditional credit: If GA for full model catalog features is not delivered by 2028-09-30, Redwood provides a one-time credit equal to 10% of the ARR committed in the contract, capped at $25,000. Credit is applied to the next invoice after the missed deadline.
B) Short-term rate discount: 15% discount on usage for a 90-day window starting from OpenForm's original intended go-live date (they indicated mid-April). Discount capped at $20,000.
C) Hybrid: Provide the early route-pinning flag (no charge) + 5% conditional credit (cap $10k) if GA misses 2028-09-30.

Other notes: any remedy must be subject to a simple amendment (one-page addendum) and require authorization from VP Commercial (Lauren) + sign-off from Legal. We should avoid credits that reduce recognized revenue without a compensating milestone.

Next steps: If Product confirms we can deliver the early flag by 2028-05-15, I'd push for option C — it demonstrates technical support and keeps the commercial exposure bounded. Priya, with your permission I'll draft the addendum and loop Legal.

Ben Carter
Head of Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Need commercial remedy for model-catalog delay

Agree with Ben's hybrid (option C). Approve provisionally on the condition that:
1) Product confirms and commits to the 2028-05-15 gated early-flag delivery timeline in writing.
2) Legal prepares a one-page amendment limiting the credit exposure and tying any credit to the GA-miss date (2028-09-30).
3) We include a clause that the early-flag is provided as-is for a limited time and OpenForm acknowledges the mitigant limitations.

Priya — please send Samir a clear response today: offer the early route-pinning preview + the small conditional credit (5% up to $10k) if GA misses 2028-09-30, and note that this is subject to the addendum & Legal review. If they accept, have them confirm the intended mid-April go-live window (we need that anchor to start the 90-day clock in the fallback).

I'll take the approval to Legal and Finance after we have Product's written commitment.

Lauren Bishop
VP, Sales Strategy & Operations
Redwood Inference
